lane_summaries.description: strict reviewed deoxynucleoside/thymidine/deoxycytidine/deoxyguanosine kinase split from broad EC 2.7
lane_summaries.query: (reviewed:true) AND (ec:2.7.1.*) AND ((protein_name:"deoxynucleoside kinase") OR (protein_name:"thymidine kinase") OR (protein_name:"deoxyguanosine kinase") OR (protein_name:"deoxycytidine kinase")) NOT ((ec:2.7.11.*) OR (ec:2.7.13.*) OR (ec:3.*) OR (protein_name:"protein kinase"))
lane_summaries.recommendation_reason: backup split: mechanism-rich sample, but smaller reviewed supply and one sampled boundary signal

lane_summaries.description: strict reviewed GHMP-like small-molecule kinase split using homoserine/mevalonate/phosphomevalonate/galactokinase names
lane_summaries.query: (reviewed:true) AND (ec:2.7.1.*) AND ((protein_name:"homoserine kinase") OR (protein_name:"mevalonate kinase") OR (protein_name:"phosphomevalonate kinase") OR (protein_name:"galactokinase")) NOT ((ec:2.7.11.*) OR (ec:2.7.13.*) OR (ec:3.*) OR (protein_name:"protein kinase"))
lane_summaries.recommendation_reason: backup split: clean sampled boundary profile, but smaller reviewed supply and fewer sampled active/binding-site handles than ASKHA

lane_summaries.description: strict reviewed ASKHA/sugar-acetate kinase split using acetate/glucose/hexose/glycerol kinase names
lane_summaries.query: (reviewed:true) AND (ec:2.7.1.*) AND ((protein_name:"acetate kinase") OR (protein_name:"glucokinase") OR (protein_name:"hexokinase") OR (protein_name:"glycerol kinase")) NOT ((ec:2.7.11.*) OR (ec:2.7.13.*) OR (ec:3.*) OR (protein_name:"protein kinase"))
lane_summaries.recommendation_reason: preferred next split: largest reviewed supply among sampled strict lanes, 39/40 likely wireable, and zero sampled boundary signals

recommendation.blocked_boundary: broad EC 2.7 remains blocked; do not merge kinase subclasses or count EC as mechanism evidence
recommendation.next_exact_action: wire ASKHA/sugar-acetate kinase only after fingerprint/ontology spec, 29fp OOS prereg re-freeze, disambiguation guards, tests, non-destructive preview, and gated apply
